checkedAlternates.risk: TOML supports nested tables like JSON and YAML.
checkedAlternates.resolution: TOML is an INI-inspired sectioned config format (group-2), whereas JSON, XML, and YAML are general hierarchical interchange formats (group-3).
MessagePack encodes data in binary bytes (group-4), not human-readable text.
